content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a payer bundling denial, so the balance should not be billed to the patient while a payer challenge remains available. Prior authorization was not required, retro authorization is unavailable, and a peer-to-peer has already been requested; resubmitting unchanged would not address the adjudication. A formal appeal is therefore the proper next payer action despite its relatively low historical success rate.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
